[ASSISTANT_SAID] Provided tips for researching organizations online, including looking for clear mission statements, volunteer opportunities, project descriptions, testimonials, transparency, and contact information.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Listed red flags to be cautious about, such as lack of transparency, vagueness about projects, overemphasis on fundraising, unrealistic expectations, poor online reviews, unclear language, and lack of contact information.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested verifying the legitimacy of organizations by checking their registration status and reaching out directly with questions.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Advised on effective outreach methods, recommending email as the preferred method for initial contact, followed by phone calls or using contact forms.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested being clear and concise in outreach, showing enthusiasm for the organization's mission, and being respectful of their time.
